programme.title: Between Estonia and Finland
programme.desc: The Baltic Sea is the youngest ocean in the world and first evolved after the last Ice Age. We think we know everything about it, yet still it has many surprises in store. Wind and waves still shape the shores of the Baltic Sea. The second episode presents a world comprising tens of thousands of islands, between Estonia, Gotland in Sweden and the Finnish Archipelago Sea. In the Autumn on Saaremaa, the largest Estonian island, nasal sounds can be heard from one corner to the next: The mating calls of the Moose. Huge bulls make their way to the traditional rutting areas in the south of the island. The landscape here is stony and riddled with countless bays. In the north, the Panga Cliff, a limestone wall of some 20 metres in height and more than 400 million years old. In the beginning of March, animal filmmaker Christoph Hauschild and his team accompany two seal researchers going about their work. Their destinations are two small islands in the Bay of Riga. A popular spot for grey seals. This is the first time that a film team has been allowed on the island. Just how many animals there are, can first be seen from the air. The beach is packed with young seals. The largest gathering in the Baltic Sea. The absence of pack ice forces the mothers to come here. Global warming has visibly changed the Baltic Sea as far as the Bay of Riga. The winters are simply too hot for the well-insulated young seals. So as not to overheat, they take dips in the cooling water. The underwater camera captures intimate moments and reveals just how playfully the youngsters enjoy the cool water. Just 200 kilometres to the west lies an ancient coral reef, Gotland. The Swedish island is like an ark in the central Baltic Sea. Much of the flora and fauna one otherwise only finds in Southern Europe can be found here on the second largest island in the Baltic Sea. Golden eagles breed here in the trees and in the spring, the ground is covered in orchids. 35 different varieties grow on Gotland.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Blueberry and Huck turn the Baby Berrykins' favorite fairy tale, "The Littlest Berrykin," into a comedy play. They pitch it to director Plum and the assembled cast and crew using a large storybook. As Huck and Blueberry narrate the story, we push in on the book and its illustrations transition into animation. In the story, the King and Queen of the Berry Patch (played by Huck and Blueberry) are retiring to the tropics.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Orange wants to spend the day teaching her puppy to fetch, but the frisky little gal doesn't seem to understand the "retrieve" part of the activity-as soon as she gets the ball, she runs out of sight and returns moments later without it. Orange gets a new ball and tries again, with the same results. Over and over, until Orange is out of balls. Puzzled and frustrated that she can't find where her pup has stashed them, she goes to enlist her friends to help her search.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Cherry Jam is being driven to distraction! She can't finish a song that she promised to write for a singing group, thanks to the earsplitting noise from Berrykin construction crews who are trying to find the sparkleberry juice blockage that has shut down the town's power. Strawberry can't cook in the café, Lemon's hair salon appliances are running out of control-life in Berry Bitty City is impossible!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With the power completely out in Berry Bitty City, the girls go on a camping trip to be out of the way of the Berrykin work crews. Lemon is nervous because she believes there is a creepy creature in the forest (that she read about in a book Blueberry loaned her), and the girls get the nervous bug, but Strawberry turns their apprehension into fun by daring her friends to stay out in the woods the longest!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The girls are driven to distraction by their frisky puppies frolicking all over Berry Bitty City! Full of energy and thinking that everything in town is a toy for them to play with, they cause comical mayhem wherever they go. Strawberry suggests the pups need a place of their own where they can play, a dog park! The girls decide to call in Huckleberry, who runs an animal hotel in Berry Big City, to help design the park.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: The girls plan a formal afternoon lawn party tea to inaugurate their new dog park. Plum is in charge of decorations, Cherry music, and Strawberry snacks. There's even a giant, dog-shaped ice sculpture. As the girls get dressed, Raspberry puts the finishing touches on the high-fashion hats that will accompany their beautiful gowns. At last everything is ready. But when the gate opens... the puppies back away!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: To convince the dance-averse Huckleberry to attend the big masquerade ball at the dog park, Blueberry promises she'll stay by his side the whole evening and make sure he doesn't have to dance. But as the day of the ball dawns, Blueberry awakens with a bad cold. She doesn't know how to tell Huck that she can't go to the ball. Lemon and Raspberry misinterpret her sniffles, thinking she's so heartbroken to be disappointing Huck that she's crying!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.sub-title: The Berry Biggest, Berry Baddest Bakeoff
programme.desc: Berry Bitty City is abuzz as Berrykin Bloom introduces the biggest, juiciest, strangest fruit anyone has ever seen! It's the size of a house, shaped like a strawberry, colored like a watermelon and has a spiky pineapple top. "I call it the sparklestrawwaterpineberry!" says Berrykin Bloom. Princess Berrykin declares it the greatest achievement in Berryculture she's ever witnessed.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Lemon and Raspberry hire twins Sweet & Sour to help out in Strawberry's café, so Strawberry will have time to appear in an internet fashion contest.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry's world-traveling cousin Apple Dumplin' stops at Berry Bitty City. What starts as a brief visit becomes a series of comical misadventures that ends with Apple finding a new home with Strawberry and her friends.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Lemon and Raspberry's fashion podcast is saved by Apple, then almost sabotaged by Sweet and Sour when Lemon's "mood hair" runs amok, acting like the bickering twins, and the twins' comical argument is accidentally broadcast on the "berrynet."

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: When Sour wishes she could have a birthday all her very own, her twin sister Sweet grants her wish by forgoing celebrating her birthday. But what begins as a day that Sour has always dreamed of quickly becomes a disappointment when she misses her twin. With Strawberry's help, Sour gives her birthday back to Sweet with a special surprise.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: Can Of Worms
programme.desc: Lloyd moves in and tries to make nice by helping out with chores, but he just gets in the way. Pythor has awoken the Vipoids and the Constrictaurs and an all out snake war has taken over Ninjago. The Ninja are not faring well, when a mysterious Samurai shows up and saves the day.

programme.title: Darkness Shall Rise
programme.desc: With the Devourer destroyed, Ninjago is saved and the rebuilding effort begins. Without their Golden Weapons, the Ninja are stripped of their elemental powers. And with their flying ship ‘The Destiny's Bounty' destroyed, the Ninja are forced to find a new home in the city. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon resurfaces and gains control of the Serpentine as well as transforms the Bounty's wreckage to become ‘The Black Bounty'. The Ninja will battle Scales and discover evil has begun to resurface in Ninjago, while Lord Garmadon will successfully forge the Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.Just as the rebuilding effort in Ninjago begins, the four ninjas come to realize that evil has started to resurface with Lord Garmadon forging the ninjas' lost Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.

programme.title: Pirates Vs. Ninja
programme.desc: When Garmadon by accident brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty – the ruthless Captain Soto and his Pirates - it is up to our ninjas to stop them from plundering Ninjago City. Sharing a tiny, one-bedroom apartment in the city, the Ninja take Lloyd to Grand Sensei Darreth's Mojo Dojo to begin training. There, they discover Lloyd has all four of their natural elemental abilities. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon discovers his Mega-Weapon can't destroy, only create what the user wishes. By accident, Garmadon brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty: Captain Soto and his Pirates, and they mutiny the ship. Answering the age-old question of who would win a fight between pirates and ninja, it's up to our ninja to stop Captain Soto and his men from plundering Ninjago City. In the end, Ninjago City is saved, the Pirates are arrested and Lord Garmadon escapes once again with their Black Bounty.

programme.title: Double Trouble
programme.desc: When our heroes are invited back to Darkly's Boarding School, they discover it's a trap set up by Lord Garmadon and his evil replica ninjas created by Garmadon's new Mega-Weapo. Realizing how to correctly wield the Mega-Weapon, Lord Garmadon creates evil replicas of the Ninja to face off with our heroes. Meanwhile, Lloyd and the Ninja are invited back the Darkly's Boarding School, only to discover it's a trap and now the bad kids have seized control of the school. With the Ninja trapped in the school with the faculty, things spiral out of control as the Evil Replica Ninja arrive. As an awesome battle takes place in the school halls, the Ninja manage to outsmart their evil versions, and warn Lord Garmadon they're ready for whatever else he throws at them.

programme.title: Fright Knight
programme.desc: Using the Book of Fear, Jestro calls forth Whipperella and uses her to trap the knights in the dark woods where they realize their darkest fears. Searching through the dark forests of the realm, Jestro finds “The Book of Fear.” It's pretty scary. But he feeds it to the book of Book of Monsters, and he uses it to call forth WHIPPERELLA, a monster that can induce fear. One-by-one she uses her “knighmarish” power on the knights and they experiences their own worst fears. Clay fears not living up to the Knights' Code. Lance fears being a nobody. Macy fears never being a knight and Axl fears having no food. Aaron must take the lead because he's fearless he does everything with reckless abandon. It's not until he leads the group out of the forest – as they fight off the Whipperella – that they we find out Aaron's true fear – the fear of peace and quiet and no more challenges or high energy escapades.

programme.title: The Golden Castle
programme.desc: When Lance is cast as the star in the new remake of the classic movie “Ned Knightly and the Golden Castle” he doesn't anticipate Jestro and his monsters invading the set and ruining his starring role. It's movie time! Lance does something very Lance: he agrees to star in a movie about remake of a classic film in Knighton: “The Golden Castle.” While pillaging a village, Jestro and the Book of Monsters see a movie poster for “The Golden Castle” and the book says the legendary Golden Castle is filled with riches! Jestro explains that it's just a dumb movie and that it's not real. It's all based on a “script.” The Book, who's been shelved for many years, wants to eat the movie script to learn more about the modern world. On the set of the movie, Lance has invited the other Knights to act as extras. When they see how Lance is being portrayed, they're incensed. When Jestro attacks the movie set to get the script for his book to eat, the film director keeps rolling. This battle footage is fantastic! The Knights defeat Jestro even though the movie set is trashed. The director will make it work. At the premier of the movie, Lance is embarrassed to see that he's been reduced to comic relief for the realm's bravest Knight…Macy! The director has now made her a star.

programme.title: The Maze Of Amazement
programme.desc: The Knights find themselves trapped in a maze looking for the Book of Deception. But will they actually get their hands on it, or will it keep deceiving them? The Knights travel to the Hill Country in the northern part of Knighton to Axl's home town of DIGGINGTON (where they realize that all of Axl's family look just like him.) While they're there, Merlok 2.0 detects something…one of the Magic Books! It's “The Book of Deception.” They go to find it and discover it ended up under a mountain. And, to make matters worse, the magic book has built a maze around itself to keep it from being found (it is deceptive!) As the NEXO-Knights enter the maze from one side, Jestro enters from the other the Book of Monsters has led him to the maze to get The Book of Deception, too. It's a race through this confusing maze to see who can get the book first. Ava figures out the maze is the Whackman maze from a videogame. After help from Axl's people to defeat Jestro and win the book, the knights discover it's a FAKE BOOK of deception. The Book of Deception created a fake copy of itself!

programme.title: The Black Knight
programme.desc: It seems the NEXO-Knights are attacking villages throughout the realm! But why? A mysterious Black Knight appears to defend the cities from the rogue NEXO-villains! Jestro, happy he has the REAL Book of Deception, uses it to create bad versions of the NEXO-Knights. The “fake” knights then attack villages and hamlets. When the real NEXO-Knights arrive, they're booed and pelted with food. Why does everyone hate them? To make matters more confusing, a giant Mech Suit in black – The BLACK KNIGHT – appears to defend the kingdom's villages from the fake knights. The Black Knight ends up being very powerful and throws Jestro and his fake knights for a loop. He's cool and mysterious. But when the fake Knights get the better of him, the REAL NEXO-Knights appear to fend them off and learn their deceptive secret. The Knights save the Black Knight and they open him up to find…young ROBIN! (He used a deep, deceptive voice.) The Knights realize that Robin has potential. But maybe he still has some learning to do.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: Country Girls
programme.desc: When the girls go to Mia's grandparents' ranch and Olivia accidentally knocks down the neighbor's barn, the girls promise to raise money to rebuild it and now have to learn to set aside their differences and work together to make good on their promise. Mia invites her friends to her grandparents' ranch for the weekend. But when Olivia accidentally knocks down a neighbor's barn with a tractor, the girls promise to raise the money to rebuild it themselves. Complicating matters, Mia and Stephanie turn out to like the same boy, Martin. They'll have to learn to set aside their differences and work together if they're going to raise enough money to make good on their promise.

But no one is listening to her, especially Stephanie, who's become obsessed with beating her rival Tanya in the contest. Emma finally does find someone who appreciates her design… Tanya! programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

This is the only way they could appeal to your concerns and become your faithful friends.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This tale tells us about one Caliph from the East, who used to sit all day long in front of the window and listen to the birds chirping. Caliph was very powerful, but there was one thing that disappointed him - he could not understand the birds' language. Poor Caliph began to cry and no one was able to make him laugh. One day a strange dwarf came to Caliph. He promised to help him to turn him into a stork. Caliph agreed and turned into a stork. Meanwhile, the dwarf sat on the throne and proclaimed himself Caliph. The poor Stork burst into tears and begged the dwarf to restore his human appearance and kingship. Nothing would have saved Caliph, if only one little parrot helped Caliph to bewitch the dwarf and return the human appearance to him. Masha concludes that it is very important to learn foreign languages.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a boy called Jack. He was so poor that no girl would want to marry him. One day he went to the market to sell the cow and buy himself a suit. On his way to the market Jack met an old man, who offered him to buy a cow for a bean seed. Jack agreed and went home. There he met his mother, who realized that money was spent for nothing and threw away the seed out from the window. At night, when Jack and his mother were sleeping, the seed sprouted and grew into a tall tree. In the morning, Jack has decided to climb this tree. He attempted several times but each time he fell down. Suddenly he noticed a saw a plait hanging next to him from the tree. He pulled it down and suddenly a beautiful girl fell right into his arms. They got married and lived happily ever after. To conclude, only selfless deeds can bring true happiness.

By magic, the fairy emerged and conjured her Nutcracker, who helped Cinderella to crack all the nuts very fast. The Cinderella was so happy that she took the Nutcracker with her to the ball, which took place in the royal palace. The Nutcracker helped the King to save the palace from rats and Cinderella was so thankful that she kissed him in his cheek. In this very moment the Nutcracker turned into a handsome prince! The moral of the story is that we should not judge the others by their appearance.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: MAATA KI MAHIMA
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.17
programme.desc: Upon discovering that Jeongi is Euldam's daughter, Gangcheon expels her from the Bunwon workshop. In front of everyone, Mun Saseung kneels and begs Gangcheon to spare her. When Hwa-ryeong declares that she will live solely to defeat Jeongi, Taedo is left shaken. Soon after, Jeongi is ordered to craft a porcelain vase as a birthday gift for Royal Consort Inbin, and Gwanghae promises to support her with everything he has.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.18
programme.desc: Startled by the sound of vases shattering inside the kiln, Jeongi peers inside and suddenly collapses. Hearing that Jeongi had been guarding the kiln alone, Gwanghae turns pale and desperately searches for her. Taedo watches over the unconscious Jeongi with quiet anguish. Seeing Jeongi injured, her eyesight damaged, Gwanghae is overcome with pain—yet Jeongi asks only to be allowed back into the Bunwon.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.19
programme.desc: Claiming she has no lingering attachment, Jeongi leaves the Bunwon behind, and Gwanghae watches her go in hollow disbelief. After returning to her former home, Jeongi and Taedo are suddenly seized by military officers, who drag Taedo away. Gwanghae pleads with Inbin to release him, insisting that Taedo once served as his personal guard. Awakened by her mother Yeonok's voice, Jeongi rises and walks toward the kiln…

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.20
programme.desc: King Seonjo orders Gwanghae, Imhae, and Shinseong to find a way to end the people's widespread stomach illness, prompting Gwanghae to disguise himself and investigate in secret. While surveying the village, he unexpectedly encounters Jeongi, who is making and distributing bowls to the villagers. Jeongi carefully presents a vessel she crafted especially for Gwanghae. Soon, a royal decree is issued for the Bunwon to produce pottery for the common people, and Gwanghae sets out to find Jeongi.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.21
programme.desc: Despite Taedo's warnings that it is dangerous, Jeongi insists she must remain at the Bunwon to bring Gangcheon down from his nangcheong post. Reunited with Jeongi at the workshop, Gwanghae cannot hide his quiet delight. Meanwhile, Yukdo grows uneasy when he is forced to compete with Jeongi to create the lid for King Seonjo's cherished jar. He promises Jeongi that if she succeeds, he will elevate her to the rank of master potter.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.22
programme.desc: When King Seonjo selects Yukdo's lid, Yukdo struggles to contain his joy, while Jeongi graciously acknowledges his skill. Gwanghae petitions the king to lift the Chief Scholar's exile, but Seonjo misinterprets the request as a threat to royal authority. Seizing the moment, Inbin plots to frame Gwanghae for treason by forging his letter. As Jeongi departs on Gangcheon's errand to mine white clay, Gwanghae mounts his horse and races after her.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Meaningful Stone! Since releasing her debut single Camera in My Dreams in July 2017 she has garnered much attention with her self-produced music videos and live performance videos on YouTube. Naturally she became one of the most aspiring indie musicians in the Korean music scene who was also highly praised by renowned music critic and writer Bae Soon-tak. This past September Meaningful Stone released her first full-length album a call from my dreams which is named after the lead single off the album. As the title implies the song is about a call she received in her dreams when she was struggling with life's ups and downs. As opposed to reality she was continuously speaking words of love to herself while dreaming. She shares that hopeful message with listeners to offer a moment of comfort. In this episode Meaningful Stone performs a call from my dream nameless treasure hunt if I grow up as if and beep-boop-beep-boop. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and check out her unpredictable yet genuine musicality!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is guitarist and singer-songwriter Jukjae! This artist initially made his reputation in the music scene as a session guitarist composer and arranger. Then in April 2014 he released a self-written song View through the compilation album bright #2 and his debut album One Word in November officially starting a singing career of his own. Thanks to his dexterity in playing guitar he has played with a number of top musicians including Park Hyo-shin Kim Dong-ryul IU and more. Last month in November Jukjae released his second mini-album 2006 the year Jukjae describes as “the most beautiful and innocent time” in his life. With the lead single Shining My 2006 he hopes people will look back at the time they were at their brightest and happiest to escape reality for a brief moment. In this episode Jukjae performs Shining My 2006 The Door Do You Want To Walk With Me? Let's Go See the Stars and View. Tune in to I'm LIVE and take a glimpse into his artistry!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the talented vocalist duo GB9! GB9 is composed of Gil-gu and Bong-gu who were known for their exceptional singing skills even before their debut. They sang for a number of top-notch artists as backup vocalists including Lee Juck Park Hyo-shin Kim Jo-han Taeyang Baek Z Young Gummy Lynn Kim Tae-woo and more. The two are also top vocal coaches who taught B1A4 BTOB and Oh My Girl. In 2013 the two made their official debut with the single Going Crazy and instantly captured listeners' hearts. In 2017 the duo's 2014 single I hope it's a breeze made it to the Melon Top 100 Chart and once again proved that the song is a timeless classic. From The King of Mask Singer to Immortal Songs: Singing the Legend the two took part in various music shows and impressed viewers with their artistry. Last month in November GB9 released an emotional ballad called If I knew touching listeners once more in this cold season. In this episode GB9 performs their latest single If I knew and biggest hit I hope it's a breeze among others. Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy their flawless performance!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Ha Hyun-sang! This artist made his big debut in February 2018 with the single Dawn. Since then he has released two mini-albums and a number of singles and also taken part in the soundtracks of top TV series such as Mr. Sunshine Melo Is My Nature A Piece of Your Mind and Soul Mechanic. Last year he participated in a talent show for indie musicians Super Band as a member of Hoppipolla and managed to finish first. Last month Ha Hyun-sang released his new single 3108 which is about a guy wanting to go back in time to correct his past mistakes. Full of heartrending sentiments this song is more than good enough to get a glimpse into his fantastic artistry. In this episode Ha Hyun-sang performs 3108 Nostalgia A Book of Love and more to show off his talents. Tune in to I'm LIVE and let this artist melt your heart!

programme.title: MID WICKET TALES
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: LOST RECIPES
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

Buzz Cargo is the ‘Car2X' local warning system, which utilises signals from other vehicles and the transport infrastructure to spot hazards in real time. Also included as standard: the ‘Front Assist' emergency braking function and, in the MPV, the ‘Lane Assist' lane-keeping assistant. With new software, new assistance functions are also making their way into the ID. family. Available as an option is ‘Travel Assist with swarm data', which facilitates partially automated driving across the entire speed range and, for the first time, assisted lane-changing on the motorway. Also new: the ‘Memory Function' for automated parking on a previously saved route.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

Una volta entrati a far parte di un club internazionale e accettate le regole, ogni membro può essere sia cacciatore che preda. Dopo dieci battute di caccia portate a termine vengono concessi onori trionfali: Caroline, alla sua nona esperienza, parte per Roma, dove vive Marcello, la sua ultima preda...

programme.title: Matrimonio all'italiana

L`inganno però viene scoperto e Domenico è risoluto a sciogliere il matrimonio, ma Filumena non si arrende e cos gli rivela di avere tre figli, uno dei quali suo...

programme.title: La donna del giorno

Ritrovandosi ben presto ad affrontare i pericoli della frontiera, Jay si allea con un misterioso viaggiatore di nome Silas (Michael Fassbender), che accetta di proteggerlo in cambio di contanti. Lungo la strada, Jay si renderà conto che l'America, piena di insidie, doppi giochi e violenza, non è il luogo ideale per gli innocenti.

Quando la direzione dell'albergo decide di affidargli un altro compito e retrocederlo, per via della sua decrepitezza, a lavorare nei bagni, tutte le certezze dell'uomo vengono meno. Affezionato alla sua mansione e alla sua divisa, l'anziano portiere non riesce a darsi pace e accettare né il nuovo incarico né tutto ciò che ne conseguirà.

programme.desc: Nel west dei mitici anni della frontiera Georgia Lawshe Woods si oppone alle strette regole morali per affermare sé stessa. Si appassiona alla politica affronta i pericoli della guerra e combatte l'ostilità degli indiani.

programme.title: La banda degli onesti
programme.desc: Tre uomini perbene ma goffi che affrontano difficoltà economiche iniziano con riluttanza a fabbricare banconote false. Il figlio di uno di loro è il poliziotto che segue il caso, ignorando il coinvolgimento del padre.

programme.title: Bello Onesto Emigrato Australia Sposerebbe Compaesana Illibata
programme.desc: Bellissima commedia con Alberto Sordi e Claudia Cardinale. Un operaio emigrato in Australia cerca moglie per corrispondenza usando la foto di un amico. Lo raggiunge, senza rivelarsi, una ex prostituta. Le reciproche bugie creano divertenti malintesi.

programme.title: Half Nelson
programme.desc: Candidatura agli Oscar per Ryan Gosling. Dan è un insegnante di scuola pubblica, brillante e capace di motivare i suoi allievi nonostante le difficoltà della vita di periferia. Nel privato però affoga i suoi tormenti nell'abuso di alcool e droghe.

programme.title: Third Person
programme.desc: Tre storie di passione, fiducia e tradimento, che prendono vita in tre città diverse, dove si dipanano le vicende di tre coppie che sembrano non avere nulla in comune, se non un invisibile, flebile legame.

programme.title: La Forza del Singolo
programme.desc: P.K. Newborn era l'unico bambino inglese in una scuola afrikaans. P.K. incontra il detenuto Geel Piet che gli insegna a tirare di boxe. Geel Piet diffonde il mito del Rainmaker, colui che porta la pace tra tutte le tribù, e dice a tutti che è P.K. l'eroe che stanno aspettando.

programme.title: Miss Julie
programme.desc: Una residenza di campagna in Irlanda intorno al 1880. Nel corso di una notte di mezza estate, in un clima di baldoria selvaggia e vincoli sociali allentati, la giovane Julie e John, cameriere di suo padre, ballano e bevono, si corteggiano e manipolano.

programme.title: I segni del cuore
programme.desc: Ruby non è una liceale qualunque: le sue giornate iniziano su una barca da pesca, a fianco di suo fratello Leo, papà Frank e mamma Jackie, che sono tutti sordi. Ma la sua più grande passione è il canto e di talento ne ha da vendere.

programme.title: Il silenzio del testimone
programme.desc: Un importante avvocato difensore torna nella sua piccola città natale per difendere un vecchio amico accusato di omicidio.

programme.title: La famiglia fang
programme.desc: I coniugi Fang sono performer le cui creazioni scioccano e deliziano gli appassionati d'arte. Protagonisti sono i loro figli, pedine fondamentali delle loro opere provocatorie. Annie e Baxter, ormai adulti, sono costretti a tornare a casa dai loro genitori quando scompaiono nel nulla.

programme.title: Traffic
programme.desc: Il giudice Robert Wakefield (Michael Douglas) viene nominato dal Presidente per guidare la guerra alla droga negli USA, ma scopre che sua figlia è tossicodipendente. Intanto, un agente della DEA combatte i cartelli messicani, mentre la moglie di un narcotrafficante assume il controllo degli affari del marito. Tre storie intrecciate rivelano il lato oscuro del traffico di droga.

programme.title: The Nature of Romance
programme.desc: Una scrittrice di viaggi impegnata va a fare del campeggio di lusso in un parco naturale con la sua migliore amica e finisce per innamorarsi di una delle guardie del parco.

programme.title: Love on the Road
programme.desc: Abby, la conduttrice di un programma tv di ristrutturazione di ristoranti, riceve il nuovo incarico di trasformare una tavola calda di una piccola città in un posto ricercato. Mentre Abby e il proprietario della tavola calda, Tom, trascorrono tempo insieme, Abby scopre il significato della parola amore.

programme.title: Alvin Superstar
programme.desc: Tre scoiattoli musicisti vengono scoperti da un aspirante cantautore e vogliono diventare famosi usando le loro incredibili capacità di canto.

programme.title: Run to me
programme.desc: Alison Wynn è una triatleta dilettante che convince la dottoressa Laura Stevens, una controversa allenatrice di alte prestazioni, ad assumerla come cliente. Insieme intraprendono un rigoroso programma che combina un allenamento fisico all'avanguardia con un'ipnoterapia sperimentale nel tentativo di rendere Alison più competitiva.

programme.title: Becoming Jane
programme.sub-title: Il ritratto di una donna contro
programme.desc: Jane Austen è una ventenne romantica e indipendente nell'Inghilterra del 1795. Jane sogna un matrimonio d'amore mentre sua madre è ansiosa di accasarla con un aristocratico facoltoso. L'arrivo di Tom Lefroy, affascinante ma privo di mezzi, sconvolgerà gli equilibri della piccola comunità locale.

programme.title: Ritorno a Romance
programme.desc: Zoe Davis è una wedding planner di successo e molto determinata che vive in una grande città. Quando il padre le chiede di aiutarlo nel ristorante di famiglia, lei torna volentieri nella sua accogliente città natale di Romance, nell'Oregon.

programme.title: Cercasi fidanzato per la vacanza
programme.desc: Amy ha pianificato una vacanza perfetta per l'anniversario con il fidanzato, che però decide di interrompere la relazione. Su consiglio degli amici, decide di trovare qualcuno che abbia lo stesso.

programme.title: Here After
programme.desc: Uno sguardo oscuro sul significato dell'amore nell'aldilà.

programme.title: Argentina, 1985
programme.desc: Una battaglia alla Davide contro Golia per condannare la dittatura militare più sanguinosa dell'Argentina e garantire la giustizia alle vittime.

programme.title: Fukushima
programme.desc: Giappone, 11 marzo 2011. L'intero paese è scosso da un terribile terremoto che causa danni immensi. Lo smottamento della terra, infatti, scatena un violentissimo tsunami che si abbatte sulle coste del paese lasciandosi dietro migliaia di morti.

programme.title: Family therapy
programme.desc: Aleksander è ossessionato dall'immagine della sua famiglia perfetta, tanto da voler partecipare a un concorso per vincere un viaggio nello spazio. L'equilibrio precario esplode quando il figlio di una precedente relazione si unisce al nucleo familiare, scoperchiando bugie e segreti taciuti.

programme.title: Pushing Tin
programme.desc: Nick Falzone è il numero uno dei controllori del traffico aereo, finché un tranquillo sconosciuto, Russell Bell, non viene trasferito nel dipartimento. La rivalità tra i due migliori controllori del traffico aereo del TRACON di New York sale a un livello potenzialmente pericoloso.

programme.title: Un fidanzato in regalo
programme.desc: Callie è un'appassionata imprenditrice single che gestisce un'emergente attività di catering. Preoccupati che possa rimanere sola, i genitori le organizzano degli appuntamenti al buio per presentarle dei papabili pretendenti.

programme.title: Uno chalet per due
programme.desc: Un'amante del Natale e divorziata prenota un viaggio in uno chalet con sua madre e sua figlia. Tuttavia, lo stesso chalet viene prenotato a un scrittore single che odia il Natale. Insieme imparano la magia del Natale e della famiglia.

programme.title: The Californians
programme.desc: In una versione di 'Le bostoniane' di Henry James, una battaglia infuria tra due fratelli. Gavin, uno scaltro imprenditore, e sua sorella Olive, un'ambientalista risoluta. Ma una straordinaria cantante, Zoe, si interpone tra i due.

programme.title: Un amore di pasticceri
programme.desc: Jessie è una panettiera che ama il suo negozio più di ogni altra cosa al mondo. Quando gli sviluppatori minacciano di costringerla ad andarsene, deve salvare la sua panetteria, mentre si destreggia con una storia d'amore in piena fioritura.

programme.title: Addestramento DAmore
programme.desc: Quando una scrittice di romanzi incontra un uomo della Marina, per una ricerca per il suo prossimo libro, viene colpita dalla sua forte personalità. Sceglierà di sposare l'uomo che pensava di amare o la versione reale del suo personaggio fittizio?

programme.title: Dopo l'amore
programme.desc: Marie e Boris, dopo quindici anni di matrimonio, vivono separati in casa a causa di difficoltà economiche e per il bene delle figlie. Questo dramma contemporaneo esplora i paradossi e le sfide di una relazione che si sgretola lentamente.

programme.title: SWOP
programme.desc: Dopo aver fatto l'amore insieme per la prima volta durante una selvaggia notte al college, Lainey e Jake si separano. I loro cammini si incrociano nuovamente anni dopo ed entrambi si rendono conto che quella debosciata serata ha avuto effetti drastici sulle rispettive vite sessuali: mentre Jake è divenuto un donnaiolo, Lainey è sempre bloccata con la persona sbagliata. Nonostante si sforzino di tenere a freno il desiderio che hanno l'uno per l'altra, Lainey e Jake realizzano presto che la loro esplosiva intesa potrebbe essere la risposta a tutti i loro problemi se solo potessero smettere di dormire con altra gente.

programme.title: Fuggiamo insieme
programme.desc: Quando una ragazza appena sposata scopre che suo marito è un nazista, lo lascia e scappa con un giornalista radiofonico che si innamora di lei mentre la segue alla ricerca di una storia su suo marito.

programme.title: Fuggiamo insieme
programme.desc: Quando una ragazza appena sposata scopre che suo marito è un nazista, lo lascia e scappa con un giornalista radiofonico che si innamora di lei mentre la segue alla ricerca di una storia su suo marito.

programme.title: XX secolo
programme.desc: Un fiammante impresario di Broadway che è caduto in difficoltà cerca di convincere la sua ex amante, ora una diva di Hollywood, a tornare e far risorgere la sua carriera fallimentare.

programme.title: La Città invisibile
programme.desc: La terra trema e il mondo non è più lo stesso. Tutto cambia. Cambiano i paesaggi, le persone, la vita. Dalle rovine de L'Aquila nasce nuova vita. Questo è ciò che accade a Luca e Lucilla. Entrambi vittime del tragico terremoto del 6 aprile 2009, i due studenti universitari scelgono di non abbandonare la città e nemmeno i loro sogni.

programme.title: La Sorgente dell'Amore
programme.desc: Leila, giovane sposa magrebina, propone alle donne del suo villaggio di fare lo sciopero dell'amore: niente più sesso finché gli uomini non porteranno l'acqua al villaggio. E alla fine le donne la spunteranno.

programme.title: L'imperdibile viaggio di Harold Fry
programme.desc: Harold è un uomo qualunque che ha sempre vissuto senza prendere iniziative. Un giorno scopre che una vecchia amica è molto malata e decide di andarla a trovare attraversando a piedi l'Inghilterra.

programme.title: Tutta colpa del vulcano
programme.desc: Per i viaggiatori di tutto il mondo l'eruzione del vulcano Eyjafjallajökull è un duro colpo. Per Alain e Valerie è un disastro. Per poter arrivare nel piccolo villaggio della Grecia per il matrimonio della loro figlia, questa coppia di divorziati, che nutre un odio reciproco senza limiti, sarà costretta a intraprendere il viaggio insieme.

programme.title: L'Arte di Vincere
programme.desc: Dopo aver giocato per molti anni tra le fila degli Oakland Athletics, Billy Beane (Brad Pitt) diviene il general manager della squadra di baseball che al momento langue economicamente. Intenzionato al raggiungere il miglior risultato con la minor spesa possibile, l'uomo elabora un rivoluzionario metodo per scegliere i giocatori da acquistare e inserire nella rosa da schierare in campo. Attraverso il ricorso a modelli matematici e statistici e l'aiuto di Peter Brand (Jonah Hill), Billy in poco tempo rivoluzionerà il modo del baseball, nonostante la diffidenza di chi lo ha preceduto e il timore di chi lo circonda.

programme.title: Funny Lady
programme.desc: Barbra Streisand è più in forma che mai nei panni di Fanny Brice. Fanny rompe col suo precedente marito Nick, e fa squadra con lo scrittore di canzoni Billy Rose, un uomo che brucia di entusiasmo e ambizioni teatrali. I due formano una strana coppia, la scintillante star e il produttore novellino, e il seme dell'amore sboccia nell'amicizia. Il film è una storia sfavillante sul loro magico e toccante amore, con una Streisand indimenticabile!

programme.title: As Good as It Gets
programme.desc: Melvin odia le donne, i gay ed è pieno di manie. Ma qualcosa è destinato a cambiare. C'era una volta, un misogino, ossessionato da una serie infinita di complessi e manie e dotato di una lingua avvelenata. Ma dopo l'incontro con un cane e con una bella cameriera, qualcosa cambia e l'orco si rivela un burbero benefico.

programme.title: Tre tigri contro tre tigri
programme.desc: Secondo film ad episodi dal cast vincente: Pozzetto, Cochi, Villaggio e Montesano

programme.title: Teste di Quoio
programme.desc: Quattro terroristi assaltano l'ambasciata sbagliata a Roma, scatta l'allarme e restano bloccati

programme.title: Pane, burro e marmellata
programme.desc: Bruno, lasciato dalla moglie, trova rifugio da tre donne e diventa il sultano del loro piccolo harem

programme.title: Mi faccia causa
programme.desc: Davanti al pretore Giovanni Pennisi transita tutti i giorni un campionario di varia umanità,

programme.title: La donna scimmia
programme.desc: Commedia grottesca di Marco Ferreri con Ugo Tognazzi: Antonio scopre Maria, tutta pelosa, e la porta in tournée come fenomeno da baraccone. Tra scherzi, equivoci e situazioni assurde, il loro strano duo regala risate e sorprese.

programme.title: Il fischio al naso
programme.desc: Un uomo, interpretato da Ugo Tognazzi, si ritrova coinvolto in una serie di situazioni comiche e paradossali, tutto a causa di un fischio al naso che cambia inaspettatamente la sua vita. Una commedia surreale e ironica che esplora la follia delle circostanze.

programme.title: La donna più bella del mondo
programme.desc: Gina Lollobrigida interpreta una donna affascinante e ambiziosa che cerca di farsi strada nel mondo dello spettacolo. Tra amori e tradimenti, la sua bellezza diventa sia un vantaggio che una trappola, esplorando la superficialità e le difficoltà della fama.

programme.title: Il medico dei pazzi
programme.desc: Dalla commedia di Eduardo Scarpetta. Totò è il generoso zio di uno scapestrato nipote, che l'ha ingannato dicendo di essersi laureato e di dirigere una clinica psichiatrica (in realtà la clinica non esiste, è solo un mezzo per spillar quattrini). Totò un giorno arriva a Napoli per controllare la vita del nipotastro. Capita nella pensione di questi e prende i pensionanti per matti.

programme.title: Il club delle mamme single
programme.desc: Quando cinque mamme single in difficoltà mettono da parte le loro differenze per formare un gruppo di sostegno, trovano ispirazione e allegria nella loro nuova associazione e si aiutano a vicenda per superare gli imprevisti che ostacolano il loro cammino.

programme.title: Qualcosa di troppo
programme.desc: Con i protagonisti di “Non sposate le mie figlie” e “La famiglia Belier”.Jeanne è una madre single con alle spalle un divorzio e una discreta insofferenza verso gli uomini. Finché una mattina si risveglia con una sorpresa che le cambierà completamente la vita.

programme.title: How to Be a Latin Lover
programme.desc: Eugenio Derbez (INSTRUCTIONS NOT INCLUDED) capitana un cast stellare in questa commedia divertente e spassosissima.

programme.title: Istruzioni non incluse
programme.desc: In questa commedia esilarante Valentín è un playboy di Acapulco che vive una vita eccentrica e senza responsabilità. Un giorno sulla sua porta si presenta Julie, una sua ex scappatella che gli lascia la figlia stravolgendogli la vita.

programme.title: Love shooting
programme.desc: Charlie è un produttore cinematografico che si lascia convincere a realizzare un film su Benjamin Disraeli, a patto che il protagonista sia un attore di grande fama che però verrà rapito, costringendo Charlie ad escogitare una soluzione creativa.

programme.title: Restiamo Amici
programme.desc: Alessandro viene improvvisamente contattato, dal Brasile, dal suo vecchio amico Gigi. In punto di morte, l'uomo ha un ultimo favore: per ereditare i tre milioni di euro che gli ha lasciato suo padre deve intestarli a suo figlio. Ma Gigi non ha eredi.

programme.title: Se Permetti Non Parlarmi Di Bambini
programme.desc: Da quando si è separato, Gabriel non ha fatto altro che pensare a sua figlia Sofia. Un giorno si presenta al suo negozio di musica Vicky, una donna del suo passato, oggi più affascinante che mai, a cui però non piacciono i bambini.

programme.title: Gatto nero, gatto bianco
programme.desc: Due giovani si vogliono bene, ma le loro famiglie si oppongono. È solo il pretesto per tutto il resto di questo film unico. Il Kusturica più vero, e Leone d'Argento a Venezia

programme.title: I Coltelli del Vendicatore
programme.desc: Tra intrighi e vendetta in un'ambientazione nordica, un uomo combatte contro tradimenti e usurpatori per ristabilire giustizia, tra duelli e colpi di scena. Diretto da Mario Bava e Leopoldo Savona.

programme.title: Erik il vichingo
programme.desc: Tra terre nordiche e battaglie epiche, il guerriero Erik affronta nemici e tradimenti in una lotta per onore e potere, tra duelli e conquiste. Diretto da Mario Caiano con Giuliano Gemma.

programme.title: L'ira di Achille
programme.desc: Sullo sfondo della guerra di Troia, Achille affronta battaglie e passioni travolgenti guidato dall'onore e dalla sete di vendetta.

programme.title: Maciste all'inferno
programme.desc: Tra inferi, magie oscure e creature demoniache, Maciste affronta una sfida estrema per salvare innocenti dal male.

programme.title: La valle della vendetta
programme.desc: I figli di un barone del bestiame del Colorado, uno biologico e l'altro adottivo, si risentono e lottano per il controllo dell'impero del bestiame del padre.

programme.title: Che botte ragazzi!
programme.desc: Un sinistro boss della città chiamato Pat Barnes ha sfruttato quasi tutti in città. Se non soccombono alle sue richieste, normalmente finiscono morti. Barnes viene finalmente abbattuto da Shanghai Joe e da un venditore di olio di serpente dalla parlantina tranquilla.

programme.title: Inginocchiati straniero... I cadaveri non fanno ombra!
programme.desc: Lazar, un bounty killer, si allea con un giovane pistolero per ricattare Barrett, ex bandito e proprietario di una miniera. Alla fine della giornata, il cacciatore di taglie si scontra con Barrett, ma qualcosa va storto.

programme.title: McLintock
programme.desc: George Washington McLintock, ricco allevatore, attende il ritorno della figlia Becky e scopre che anche la moglie Katherine è tornata. Tra conflitti familiari, contadini, indiani e agenti disonesti, GW cerca di mantenere la pace e proteggere ciò che ama.

programme.title: Il suo nome è qualcuno
programme.desc: Finisce l'avventura di due soldati ribelli dopo la Guerra Civile.

programme.title: Mani di pistolero
programme.desc: Per vendetta, il pistolero Dan rapisce il figlio dello sceriffo che ha ucciso il suo bambino.

programme.title: I quattro inesorabili
programme.desc: Quattro cacciatori di taglie del Texas cercano vendetta contro un ranger che ha scagionato il loro ricercato.

programme.title: 100.000 dollari per Lassiter
programme.desc: Martin è sfruttato dai banditi finché Lassiter non gli rivela il nascondiglio di colui che lo ha reso storpio.

programme.title: Faccia a faccia
programme.desc: Un professore di storia incrocia casualmente un noto fuorilegge e finisce per guidare la sua banda.

programme.title: Il mio nome è Scopone e faccio sempre cappotto
programme.desc: Dallas e Kelly, in gara per un ranch, affrontano i fratelli Wright e altri rivali.

programme.desc: La serie che celebra i grandi attori degli ultimi 90 anni.

programme.desc: Tutte le news che vi siete persi dalla redazione di HotCorn: tra ospiti, interviste e grandi novità al cinema.

programme.title: L'Ultimo Giorno Da Rockstar
programme.desc: David Bowie ha segnato profondamente la musica rock: il documentario ci lascia un ritratto della sua carriera.

programme.desc: Il documentario ripercorre la storia del re del pop, Elvis Presley, fino alla sua improvvisa morte nel 1977.
